description: The agent and code-assist surface that is not streamed by the legacy route: the v2 chat engine's non-stream routes (/agent/v2/decision, /agent/v2/session, /agent/v2/cancel) and its SSE turn (/agent/v2/stream, whose events are in schema/agent-v2), the meeting-agent dispatch and its runs, feedback and personas, the agent catalogue and libraries (catalog, commands, generation and skill libraries), the per-user memory and tool-approval stores (project memory, session memory, tool approvals), the free-text ask and its history, and the unified chat sessions (/kb/chat/*). Rows: POST /agent/v2/stream, POST /agent/v2/decision, DELETE /agent/v2/session, POST /agent/v2/cancel, GET and PUT /agent/v2/session/route, GET /agent/v2/session/route/history, POST /kb/agent/dispatch, POST /kb/agent/stop, GET /kb/agent/runs, POST /kb/agent/feedback, GET /kb/agent/feedback/{stats,by-task}, GET and PUT /kb/agent/persona, GET and POST /kb/agent/personas, PUT /kb/agent/personas/active, PUT and DELETE /kb/agent/personas/:id, GET /kb/agent/{catalog,commands,generation-library,skill-library}, GET and DELETE /kb/agent/{project-memory,tool-approvals,session-memory}, POST /kb/agent/ask, GET and DELETE /kb/agent/ask/history, GET and POST /kb/chat/sessions, GET, PATCH and DELETE /kb/chat/sessions/:id, POST and DELETE /kb/chat/sessions/:id/messages. Not in this group: /chat and /code-assist (notes-generation and the legacy streams), /kb/loop/agent-run (loop), /kb/usage/summary and /kb/agent-sdk (providers), /kb/live/sessions (live), /kb/plan-task/update (planning), /kb/project/install-skills (kb-sources). Fixtures are captured from node server.mjs on a temp DB (127.0.0.1, seeded through the API and through the server's own kb/ helpers while the server was stopped). Model turns use the bench fake engine (LLMIDE_BENCH_FAKE=1 with --bench-fake: no model call) for /agent/v2/stream and the stub CLI (LLMIDE_ANTHROPIC_CLI, scrubbed to /example/stub-cli.mjs) for /kb/agent/ask, so no fixture carries a model's output. Repo paths are /example/repo and the workspace is /example/workspace. Exceptions, each stated on its response: POST /agent/v2/decision 200 is transcribed from the handler (a parked approval is needed to capture it); GET /kb/agent/commands 200 is x-unspecified (commands come from enabled plugins, and no plugin in the capture declares one). The catalog's plugin subagents are open: the entry shape is the plugin's own manifest and no capture plugin declares one, so the item is typed as an open object. Request fields the fixtures do not exercise are x-optional (the v2 stream's turn options and the decision's answer fields), not dropped. The 400 for a malformed JSON body (every JSON route) is not declared per route, as SCHEMA.md says. Session router (K1 Phase 6b, API 91): GET and PUT /agent/v2/session/route (the per-chat provider/model pick and billable-token cap) and GET /agent/v2/session/route/history (switch history from agent.db, degraded:true when it is down). PUT answers 409 ROUTE_CONFLICT (details.current) for a stale ifSeq or ROUTER_DISABLED, 503 ROUTE_UNAVAILABLE when the store fails. /agent/v2/stream additionally answers 402 SESSION_TOKEN_LIMIT (details {used, limit}; a distinct status because 409 is the turn lock and clients retry it) and 503 ROUTE_UNAVAILABLE, both before any model call, only with LLMIDE_ROUTER=on.

LegacyPersona.description: The legacy single-persona surface (GET and PUT /kb/agent/persona): the stored fields only, no id.

Persona.description: A row of the multi-persona registry (kb/personas.mjs). id 'default' is the migrated legacy persona.

ChatSession.description: A unified chat session (kb/chat-sessions.mjs). createdAt and updatedAt are epoch seconds with a fraction.

meta.description: Caller-supplied metadata stored as sent; the server does not interpret it.

LibraryEntry.description: A kit template or command (generation-library). surface divides the Doc Gen and Visual menus.

body.description: the Markdown body the app seeds into the project

projectRoot.description: Absolute workspace root the rule applies to

pattern.description: Command prefix for shell tools; empty = the whole tool

approvals.description: pre-0034 global grants, no longer honoured by either engine, still listed and revocable

RouteState.description: One chat's route (K1 Phase 6b). `enabled` is false when the server runs without LLMIDE_ROUTER=on: the record then reads as the empty default and PUT answers 409 ROUTER_DISABLED. `capEnforced` says whether LLMIDE_ROUTER_CAP=on, i.e. whether tokenLimit is enforced or only stored. provider '' and model '' = not pinned: the client's own pick governs.

provider.description: anthropic, custom:<id>, or '' when not pinned

tokenLimit.description: billable tokens for the chat; null = no cap

cacheRead.description: shown, never counted against the cap

billable.description: input + output + cache write: what the session cap counts

stickyUntil.description: UTC ISO; the time the last turn's prompt cache is expected to expire

warm.description: '<provider>|<model>' to the last cache touch (UTC ISO)

switchSeq.description: compare-and-set version: send it back as ifSeq

pending.description: a provider/model change made during a turn, applied at the next turn start

reason.description: user | rate_limit | error | cap, or the handoff source (client | extractive)

message.description: User message. Fence sentinels are neutralised, then capped at 120 000 chars; the message and attachments share one 150 000-char turn budget, message first. An over-cap message is truncated and the model is told so in-band, not rejected.

chatSessionId.description: Mac chat session id — the mapping key

workspaceRoot.description: Workspace the engine roots its reads in

mode.description: Chat mode; plan/assist_plan map to SDK plan permission mode; ask = read-only quick chat (menu bar / sheet / phone): no file edits, no shell, no git actions

model.description: Model id from the picker, passed to the SDK verbatim (an Anthropic id, or the custom provider's own id on a gateway turn); omitted = config default

provider.description: Provider the turn runs on (server v43+): `anthropic` (default when omitted) or an Anthropic-compatible custom provider `custom:<uuid>` registered with an `anthropicBaseURL`. The engine points the Agent SDK at that endpoint with the provider's own key and meters the turn under this id. Any other value fails before the SDK spawns with a terminal error event coded `PROVIDER_NOT_AGENT_CAPABLE` (no Anthropic-compatible endpoint) or `PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE` (unregistered / disabled / no key).

skills.description: Invoked skill ids (max 5); bodies are prompt-injected

planExecute.description: Set only by the Mac saved-plan card's "Execute plan" action: this Execute turn is working an already-approved plan, so the server injects the plan-execution skill (subagent-driven-development when the user has subagents, executing-plans otherwise). Omitted on every other request.

permissionMode.description: Claude Code's modes. `ask` (default; `manual` is its old spelling): prompt-tier calls park an approval unless a saved project rule covers them. `accept-edits`: in-workspace Edit/Write run unasked, shell still asks. `bypass`: nothing that would park asks. No mode lifts the blocklist or write containment.

attachments.description: File attachments (max 30 files, 80 000 chars each, 200 000 total)

fresh.description: Skip the recorded SDK session id and start a new one

history.description: read only when fresh is true

action.description: allow, deny or answer; may be omitted when answers is sent (the server then answers)

answers.description: question to answer (AskUserQuestion approval): question text to chosen answer

feedback.description: With `deny`: the user's instruction, handed to the model as the denial reason (max 2000 chars)

sdkSessionId.description: the SDK session the chat was bound to, or null when it had none

cancelled.description: false when no turn was in flight for the chat

attached.description: false when the session already had a loop attached

reason.description: set only when attached is false: already-attached
set only when stopped is false: unknown-session or forbidden

lastDecision.description: the loop's last candidate decision (agents/meeting-agent.mjs recordDecision); null until the loop has judged one

sinceDays.description: The window in days; the default is 30.

avgScore.description: mean score per verdict, keyed by verdict

sinceDays.description: The window in days; the default is 30.

persona.description: the stored persona, or null when none is set

items.description: one entry per enabled plugin that declares subagents; the entry is the plugin's own manifest data (pluginName, pluginDisplayName, subagents) and no capture plugin declares one, so it is not pinned

200.x-unspecified: commands come from enabled plugins that ship a slash command; the capture server has only the bundled claude-project-artifact plugin, which ships none, so the list is always empty offline. Pin it once a plugin with a command is part of the capture.

repo.description: an indexed repo path; resolved against the allow-list
the resolved absolute root, or null when no candidate is allow-listed
Absolute root from the GET above

fact.description: one fact to remove, by its identity

all.description: true clears every fact of the repo

projectRoot.description: with toolName and pattern: one project rule

all.description: Revoke every rule and legacy grant

sessionId.description: the chat's id; a blank value answers 400

image.description: one base64 image, capped per image; not exercised offline

history.description: the prior turns of this chat; only the last 10 are sent to the model

limit.description: Returns the newest N messages, oldest first; the default is 50, and reads are capped at 500.
The default is 50, with a minimum of 1 and a cap of 200.

offset.description: Skip this many rows (newest first, ties by id): page through every chat with limit.

surface.description: mac, extension or any; default any

mode.description: ask, agent or transcript; default ask

limit.description: Maximum messages returned; the default is 200, with a minimum of 1 and a cap of 2000.

provider.description: anthropic or custom:<id>; sent with model, '' with '' unpins

tokenLimit.description: whole billable tokens; null or 0 clears; negative, fractional or above 1e12 is 400

tokensUsed.description: re-seeds the counter of a chat whose route was purged at quit; ignored while the row already has usage

ifSeq.description: the switchSeq last read; a stale value is 409 ROUTE_CONFLICT

200.description: One chat's route (K1 Phase 6b). `enabled` is false when the server runs without LLMIDE_ROUTER=on: the record then reads as the empty default and PUT answers 409 ROUTER_DISABLED. `capEnforced` says whether LLMIDE_ROUTER_CAP=on, i.e. whether tokenLimit is enforced or only stored. provider '' and model '' = not pinned: the client's own pick governs.

tokenLimit.description: billable tokens for the chat; null = no cap
